_why: This client runs MCP server-side and exposes a connector URL field with no header field. There is no config file to paste, so this endpoint returns the install path instead of a config block.

install.instruction: Open the DC Hub connector settings and paste the server URL above. That is the whole install — no config file, no header, no restart beyond reconnecting the connector.
install.auth: Leave auth blank — DC Hub answers keyless at free-tier depth. For a higher allowance, call the `claim_free_key` tool once connected; it returns a `connect_url` that carries the key in the URL, which is the only durable state on this kind of client.
